title: Cage n(3,17): a 3-regular graph of girth 17 with few vertices
statement: Find a 3-regular simple graph whose girth (shortest cycle) is at least 17, with as few vertices n as possible; it shows n(3,17) <= n (cages grow with the girth). The best known (k,g)-graph in the House of Graphs cage table has 2048 vertices [EGJSV26]; a graph with fewer vertices improves it.
submission: Text file: one graph in graph6 or sparse6 (as House of Graphs gives them; an optional >>graph6<< or >>sparse6<< header is allowed), or an edge list, one edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered from 0.
score: n, the number of vertices of a 3-regular graph of girth at least 17 (smaller is better)
